spirit:component.spirit:description: This IP provides QDMA behaviors and interfaces by expanding native capabilities of CPM6 DMA/Bridge Mode for PCIe. To access this IP, please use the Vivado open example project wizard to browse available PCIe project templates for CPM6. For more information about CPM6 DMA/Bridge mode for PCIe, please refer to PG463.
